```ts
  params?: Record<string, unknown>; // `generation` (number) = the re-register knob (changes the key)
};
export type AssetRecord = {
  assetId: string;           // ark sends it as asset://<assetId>
  provider: string;          // e.g. "ark"
  account: string;           // provider-computed one-way account fingerprint
  groupId: string;
  registeredAt: number;      // epoch ms when the provider reported it active
};
export type AssetResult = {
  body: Uint8Array;          // encodeAssetRecord(record) — the runner stores it as is
  mimeType: typeof ASSET_MIME;
  costUsd: number;
  meta?: { assetId: string; account: string };
};
export type AssetJobPoll =
  | { state: "pending" }
  | ({ state: "done" } & AssetResult)
  | { state: "failed"; error: unknown };   // refusal: error.kind === "content-policy" → item flagged
export type AssetHandler = {               // submit + poll only (registration is async upstream)
  estimate(request: AssetRequest): { usd: number };
  submit(request: AssetRequest, opts: { signal?: AbortSignal }): Promise<{ jobId: string }>;
  poll(jobId: string, request: AssetRequest, opts: { signal?: AbortSignal }): Promise<AssetJobPoll>;
};
export function encodeAssetRecord(record: AssetRecord): Uint8Array; // UTF-8 JSON, stable key order
export function parseAssetRecord(bytes: Uint8Array): AssetRecord;   // throws the pinned error

export type Config = {
  defaultProvider: string;   // default "ark"
  pollIntervalMs: number;    // default 3000 (facade only; the runner uses runner.pollIntervalMs)
};
export type AssetApi = {
  // One-off, NOT journaled, NOT cached: submit once, poll every pollIntervalMs,
  // parse the done body; a failed poll rethrows its error; abort rejects with the reason.
  register(request: AssetRequest, opts?: { provider?: string; signal?: AbortSignal }): Promise<AssetRecord>;
  estimate(request: AssetRequest, opts?: { provider?: string }): { usd: number }; // ark: 0
  providers(): string[];     // registry.providers("asset")
};
```

Build file:

```yaml
items:
  - id: face-mira
    task: asset
    provider: ark
    input: { image: { $file: faces/mira.png }, url: "https://cdn.example/faces/mira.png" }
    params: { generation: 1 }   # bump to register again (dead asset, new account)
  - id: clip-01
    task: video
    provider: ark
    input: { model: dreamina-seedance-2-5-260628, prompt: "image 1 walks into the rain",
             refs: [{ $ref: face-mira }], seconds: 10 }
```

A flagged asset item leaves every item that `$ref`s it queued (logged runner:blocked),
never dispatched. A video provider that cannot use assets (fal) refuses an ASSET_MIME
input before any upload with a terminal 400.
Errors: `[ai] No asset provider named "<name>" is registered.\n  Available: <list or "none">.`
(also for a value that fails isAssetHandler) · `[ai] Not an asset record: <reason>.\n  Expected
JSON with assetId, provider, account, groupId, registeredAt.`

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
4.16 ark — app.ark (Complex tier; depends: [registryPlugin])
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Seedance straight from ByteDance. One instance = one region + one account. onInit
registers ("video","ark"), ("asset","ark") and ("image","ark"). Video and asset are
submit + poll (no execute); image is execute only (Seedream, POST {dataPlane}/images/generations).
Registered AFTER fal in src/index.ts, so registry.providers("video")[0] === "fal" and
fal stays the default video provider. Imports contract modules (asset/contract,
video/contract) only — no import from fal. fetch + node:crypto, no package.

Regions:
- intl (default): BytePlus ModelArk — data plane https://ark.ap-southeast.bytepluses.com/api/v3
  (video, Bearer ARK_API_KEY), control plane https://ark.ap-southeast-1.byteplusapi.com
  (assets, HMAC-SHA256 signed with ARK_ACCESS_KEY/ARK_SECRET_KEY, sign region
  ap-southeast-1, service ark), prices in USD.
- cn: Volcengine Ark — https://ark.cn-beijing.volces.com/api/v3 and
  https://open.volcengineapi.com, sign region cn-beijing, prices in CNY.
Control-plane calls: POST {controlPlane}/?Action=<Action>&Version=2024-01-01, JSON body.

Prerequisites for real use: "Seedance Advanced Creation Rights" on the account (asset
API) and a one-time AIGC authorization letter in the console. groupId: leave null for
the first run; the first registration of the process creates a group (CreateAssetGroup
{ GroupType: "AIGC", Name: groupName }) and logs `ark:asset:group-created { groupId,
hint }` — set config groupId to it afterwards (an account holds at most 50 groups).

```ts
export type Config = {
  region: "intl" | "cn";           // default "intl"
  apiKeyEnv: string;               // default "ARK_API_KEY" (video)
  accessKeyEnv: string;            // default "ARK_ACCESS_KEY" (assets)
  secretKeyEnv: string;            // default "ARK_SECRET_KEY" (assets)
  baseUrl: string | null;          // default null = region data plane
  controlUrl: string | null;       // default null = region control plane
  groupId: string | null;          // default null = create one per process and log it
  groupName: string;               // default "moku-ai"
  timeoutMs: number;               // default 60_000
  downloadTimeoutMs: number;       // default 300_000 (one clip or image download)
  priceOverrides: Record<string, number>; // USD per 1M output tokens by model id
  cnyPerUsd: number;               // default 7.1
};
export type State = {
  group: Promise<string> | null;   // single-flight group id
  account: string | null;          // fingerprint cache
  activeAssets: Set<string>;       // GetAsset preflight cache (per process)
  negativeWarned: boolean;
};
export type ArkInfo = {
  provider: "ark"; region: "intl" | "cn";
  configured: { video: boolean; assets: boolean }; // env presence via ctx.env.get, never throws
  models: string[];                // the region's ids
};
export type ArkApi = { info(): ArkInfo };  // no network call
// Error classes (values in ArkErrors; types under Ark), same structural shape as fal's:
// RetryableProviderError { status?, kind?: "timeout"|"network", retryAfterMs? },
// TerminalProviderError { status, code? }, FlaggedProviderError { kind: "content-policy" }.
```

Models (ids and prices from summaries of the rate cards — verify in console):

| model                        | region | max clip | resolutions        | refs img/vid/aud | price per 1M out tokens (base / with video input) |
|------------------------------|--------|----------|--------------------|------------------|------|
| dreamina-seedance-2-0-260128 | intl   | 15 s     | 480p, 720p, 1080p  | 9 / 3 / 3        | $7.0 / $4.3 |
| dreamina-seedance-2-5-260628 | intl   | 30 s     | 480p, 720p         | 30 / 10 / 10     | $10.7 / $6.4 |
| doubao-seedance-2-0-260128   | cn     | 15 s     | 480p, 720p, 1080p  | 9 / 3 / 3        | ¥46 / ¥28 |
| doubao-seedance-2-5-260628   | cn     | 30 s     | 480p, 720p         | 30 / 10 / 10     | ¥70 / ¥42 |
Min 4 s on every row; defaults seconds 5, resolution 720p, aspect 9:16; no row takes a seed.

Video body (POST {base}/contents/generations/tasks): model; content[0] text (prompt as
written); image → image_url role first_frame; endImage → last_frame; refs →
reference_image (request order); a local image is data:<mime>;base64,...; an
ASSET_MIME input is asset://<assetId>; seconds → duration; aspect → ratio (16:9, 9:16,
1:1, 4:3, 3:4, 21:9, adaptive); resolution; audio → generate_audio; negative dropped
(one ark:negative:ignored warning). params allowlist: refUrls, watermark (default
false), seed (only with seed support), return_last_frame, execution_expires_after,
priority, omni_reference_task_type; anything else → `[ai] Unknown ark param "<key>".\n  Allowed: ...`.
params.omni_reference_task_type: auto | reference | edit | extend (Seedance 2.5 omni
reference task), sent only when given; another value →
`[ai] ark params.omni_reference_task_type "<value>" is not supported.\n  Use one of: auto, reference, edit, extend.`;
refused on a final from a draft. Ark codes InvalidParameter.TaskTypeConstraint and
InvalidParameter.TaskTypeMismatch (HTTP 400 at submit, or error.code of a failed task) are
terminal with the reason on a second line.
params.refUrls: string[] — video/audio refs by PUBLIC https URL (caller hosts them; ark
never uploads): .mp4/.mov → video_url reference_video, .mp3/.wav → audio_url
reference_audio, after the image refs. A local video/audio file in refs →
`[ai] ark takes video and audio references by public URL only.\n  Pass them in params.refUrls.`

Asset preflight (in submit, before the POST, for every ASSET_MIME input):
record.provider === "ark" · record.account === own fingerprint · GetAsset Status
"Active" (cached per process). Any failure is terminal and nothing is POSTed.

Poll (GET .../tasks/{id}): queued/running → pending; succeeded → download
content.video_url at once (expires 24 h) → done video/mp4, meta { taskId, model,
seconds, resolution, completionTokens, lastFrameUrl? }; failed + /SensitiveContent/
code → flagged; failed other → terminal 400; expired/cancelled → terminal 410.
Cost = usage.completion_tokens / 1e6 × price (withVideoInput when refUrls holds a video
URL; priceOverrides[model] USD wins; cn ÷ cnyPerUsd). Estimate (no file read) = w×h×24×
seconds/1024 tokens at the base price (480p 864×480, 720p 1280×720, 1080p 1920×1080).

Face refusal: a SensitiveContent refusal of a request with a plain local image →
`[ai] ark refused an image with a face: <code>.\n  Use a Seedream image made by provider ark on this account, bytes unchanged, or an asset item.`;
otherwise `[ai] ark flagged the request: <code>.\n  Change the prompt or the inputs.`
No raw-photo fallback, no on-refusal registration (CreateAsset needs a public URL).

Asset handler: estimate { usd: 0 }. submit: group "aigc" only · input.url must be a
public https URL (`[ai] ark CreateAsset needs a public https url.\n  Pass input.url with
the same bytes as input.image.`) — url is part of the artifact key · local image PNG/
JPEG/WebP, < 30 MB, 300–6000 px per side, W/H 0.4–2.5 (header probe) · group (config
groupId or single-flight CreateAssetGroup) · CreateAsset { GroupId, URL, AssetType:
"Image", Name } → jobId "<groupId>/<assetId>". poll: GetAsset { Id } — Processing →
pending; Active → done { body: encodeAssetRecord(...), mimeType: ASSET_MIME, costUsd:
0, meta }; Failed → flagged `[ai] ark refused asset "<name>": <FailedReason>.\n  Items
that use it will not run.` A dead asset: bump params.generation on the asset item.

Account fingerprint: sha256("moku-ai:" + region + ":" + accessKey).slice(0, 12) —
one-way, never contains the key; region included (same key in two regions = two
accounts). Mismatch → `[ai] Asset "<assetId>" belongs to another ark account.\n  Register
the portrait again with this account's keys.`

HTTP mapping: 429 → retryable (Retry-After seconds or HTTP date); 5xx → retryable;
timeout/network → retryable kind; 400/422 SensitiveContent → flagged; other 4xx →
terminal `[ai] ark <Action or path> failed (<status> <code>): <message>.`. OpenAPI
envelope ResponseMetadata.Error: Throttling*/RequestLimitExceeded*/FlowLimitExceeded*/
TooManyRequests* → retryable 429; QuotaExceeded/AccessDenied*/InvalidAuthorization* →
terminal with an entitlement hint; other → terminal.
Logs (redacted — ids, codes, statuses; never keys or URLs): ark:video:submitted,
ark:video:done, ark:video:failed, ark:asset:group-created, ark:asset:registered,
ark:asset:refused, ark:negative:ignored.
Tests are local on mocked fetch; __tests__/fixtures.ts copies documented examples
(ark-mcp: asset library contract spec, Seedance adapter + contract tests, OpenAPI
signing script) with a // source: per fixture, and built bodies toEqual them.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
4.17 music — app.music (Standard tier; depends: [registryPlugin]; stateless)
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Owns the "music" task contract; providers implement + register it; this plugin
exposes a one-off facade. A handler has `estimate` plus either `execute`, or the async
pair `submit` + `poll` (or both). The runner prefers `submit`/`poll` and journals the job
id; the facade `generate` prefers `execute`, else submits and polls every
`pollIntervalMs`. The ONE audited cast is behind `isMusicHandler` (module export, not on
app.music). contract.ts imports nothing. The result shape matches VoiceoverResult: the
runner stores `audio` and maps audio/mpeg to `.mp3`.

`MusicRequest.model` is REQUIRED: the runner hashes the input as written, so a model
defaulted inside a provider would not be part of the artifact key. No fallback between
models.

Contract (src/plugins/music/contract.ts; `Music.*` namespace):

```ts
export type MusicChunk = {
  /** Lyrics or section description. */
  text: string;
  /** Section length, ms. */
  durationMs: number;
  /** Positive style tags. */
  styles: string[];
  /** Negative style tags. */
  avoid?: string[];
};

export type MusicRequest = {
  /** Overall music prompt. */
  prompt: string;
  /** Provider-scoped model alias, e.g. "elevenlabs-music-v2.5". Required: price, endpoint and output depend on it. */
  model: string;
  /** Track length, ms. */
  lengthMs: number;
  /** Composition plan; a model without plans rejects it (provider rule, never dropped silently). */
  chunks?: MusicChunk[];
  /** Seed, when the model takes one. */
  seed?: number;
  /** Provider params; each provider documents which keys it reads (fal reads none). */
  params?: Record<string, unknown>;
};

export type MusicResult = {
  /** The generated audio bytes. */
  audio: Uint8Array;
  /** MIME type of `audio`, e.g. "audio/mpeg". */
  mimeType: string;
  /** Actual cost of this generation, in US dollars. */
  costUsd: number;
  /** Metadata only, never a payload echo (e.g. model, endpoint, requestId, lengthMs). */
  meta?: Record<string, unknown>;
};

export type MusicJobPoll =
  | { state: "pending" }
  | ({ state: "done" } & MusicResult)
  | { state: "failed"; error: unknown };

export type MusicHandler = {
  estimate(request: MusicRequest): { usd: number };
  execute?(request: MusicRequest, opts: { signal?: AbortSignal }): Promise<MusicResult>;
  submit?(request: MusicRequest, opts: { signal?: AbortSignal }): Promise<{ jobId: string }>;
  poll?(
    jobId: string,
    request: MusicRequest,
    opts: { signal?: AbortSignal }
  ): Promise<MusicJobPoll>;
};
```

Plugin types (src/plugins/music/types.ts):

```ts
export type Config = {
  /** Provider used by the facade when the caller names none. Default: "fal". */
  defaultProvider: string;
  /** Facade poll cadence for submit/poll providers, ms. Default: 5000. */
  pollIntervalMs: number;
};

export type MusicApi = {
  // One-off, NOT journaled. execute when present, else submit + poll every
  // config.pollIntervalMs; a failed job throws its error as-is; abort rejects with the reason.
  generate(
    request: MusicRequest,
    opts?: { provider?: string; signal?: AbortSignal }
  ): Promise<MusicResult>;
  estimate(request: MusicRequest, opts?: { provider?: string }): { usd: number };
  providers(): string[];     // registry.providers("music"), registration order
};
```

Build file:

```yaml
- task: music
  id: teaser-score
  input:
    model: "elevenlabs-music-v2.5"
    prompt: "Tense synth pulse, rising."
    lengthMs: 30000
```

Errors: `[ai] No music provider named "<name>" is registered.\n  Available: <list or "none">.`
(also for a value that fails isMusicHandler).

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
4.18 fal — app.fal (Complex tier; depends: [registryPlugin])
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Every fal-hosted task over one client (client/http.ts, client/queue.ts,
client/upload.ts), one FAL_KEY, one upload cache and one merged price table. onInit
registers six handlers: ("video","fal"), ("image","fal"), ("prompt-gen","fal"),
("music","fal"), ("sfx","fal"), ("sprite","fal"). Emits no events. Each task directory
(video/, image/, llm/, music/, sfx/, sprite/) owns its models and prices.

- video: submit + poll (no execute). Aliases seedance-2.5, seedance-2.5-ref,
  minimax-h3, minimax-h3-max-ref, minimax-h3-max-i2v, minimax-h3-ref,
  minimax-h3-max-extend, kling-3-pro, kling-o3-ref, kling-o3-v2v-ref,
  seedance-2.0-mini, seedance-2.0-mini-ref, seedance-2.0-ref, wan-3.0-ref,
  veo-3.1-fast, vidu-q3, vidu-q3-ref, gemini-omni-1.1-flash,
  gemini-omni-1.1-flash-ref. USD per second.
- image: estimate + execute + submit + poll over the queue. Aliases nano-banana-pro,
  seedream-4.5-edit, gpt-image-2.5 (default: imageDefaultModel). A request with refs
  goes to the edit endpoint. params.resolution 1K / 2K / 4K / 1080; params.quality (gpt).
  gpt-image-2.5 only: params.background "auto" | "transparent" | "opaque" (other values
  are not sent). transparent with no known params.output_format (jpeg, png, webp) → png;
  transparent + output_format "jpeg" → TerminalProviderError 400 before the key is read
  or any ref is uploaded. Without background the default output_format stays jpeg.
  nano-banana-pro and seedream-4.5-edit never send background.
- prompt-gen: estimate + execute, one sync POST to
  `<runUrl>/openrouter/router/openai/v1/chat/completions`. `model` is an OpenRouter id;
  undefined or "default" → llmDefaultModel. Listed: anthropic/claude-opus-5.5 (default),
  anthropic/claude-sonnet-5, openai/gpt-6-sol, openai/gpt-6-astra,
  google/gemini-3.8-flash, x-ai/grok-4.7. Params: reasoning, responseSchema,
  strictSchema, images, max_tokens. 401/403 → PromptGenUnavailableError reason auth,
  402/429 → reason limit (promptGen moves to its next fallback provider). Tool calling:
  messages → chat messages after system (image parts uploaded like params.images), tools →
  tools[{ type: "function", function }], toolChoice → tool_choice, cacheSystem and text parts
  with cache: true → cache_control { type: "ephemeral" }; tool_calls → toolCalls (arguments
  not JSON → ToolArgumentsError, never retried); typed usage incl. cached and cache-write
  tokens. See src/plugins/fal/README.md "Tool calling and cache".
- music: estimate + execute + submit + poll. elevenlabs-music-v2.5
  (fal-ai/elevenlabs/music/v2.5, 3 000–600 000 ms, per started minute; chunks →
  composition_plan) and stable-audio-2.5 (fal-ai/stable-audio-25/text-to-audio,
  1 000–190 000 ms, per generation). Chunks: 3 000–120 000 ms each, at most 30, adding
  up to lengthMs. `params` never reach the body.
- sfx: estimate + execute. elevenlabs-sfx-v2 (fal-ai/elevenlabs/sound-effects/v2,
  500–22 000 ms, per started second; no durationMs bills the 22 s cap). A result that
  is not mp3 is terminal (415).
- sprite: estimate + execute. birefnet (per image) uploads the source, removes the
  background, then runs processSprite; none ($0) makes no fal call.

Image, music, sfx and sprite `execute` submit, then wait in process every `pollIntervalMs`, at most
`jobTimeoutMs` (then a retryable `kind: "timeout"`; the job keeps running on fal and
stays adoptable through `poll`). Every handler validates and prices a request before
it reads the key, uploads or POSTs; a model without a price throws from `estimate`.

Prices — one table: each task's bundled rows, then `priceOverrides` (overrides win).
Video keys are unprefixed (`<alias>`, `<alias>@<resolution>`, `<alias>+audio`,
`<alias>#ref*`); the other tasks carry the task: `image:<alias>` /
`image:<alias>@<resolution>` (USD per image), `music:<alias>` (USD per started minute
or per generation), `sfx:<alias>` (USD per started second), `sprite:<alias>` (USD per
image), `llm:<id>#in` / `llm:<id>#out` (USD per M tokens). Bundled:
image:nano-banana-pro@1K/@2K/@4K 0.15/0.15/0.30, image:seedream-4.5-edit 0.04,
image:gpt-image-2.5 0.05, image:gpt-image-2.5@2K 0.06, music:elevenlabs-music-v2.5 0.80, music:stable-audio-2.5 0.20,
sfx:elevenlabs-sfx-v2 0.002, sprite:birefnet 0.002.

Types (src/plugins/fal/types.ts; `Fal.*` namespace):

```ts
export type UploadMode = "storage" | "data-uri";

export type Config = {
  /** Env var name holding the fal key — resolved via ctx.env at request time, never stored. Default: "FAL_KEY". */
  apiKeyEnv: string;
  /** Queue base URL. Default: "https://queue.fal.run". */
  queueUrl: string;
  /** Storage upload initiate URL. Default: "https://rest.alpha.fal.ai/storage/upload/initiate?storage_type=fal-cdn-v3". */
  uploadUrl: string;
  /** How local files reach fal. Default: "storage". */
  upload: UploadMode;
  /** Per HTTP request timeout, ms. Default: 60_000. */
  timeoutMs: number;
  /**
   * Price overrides, one table for every task. Video: `<alias>`, `<alias>@<resolution>`, `<alias>+audio`
   * (USD/s) or a `<alias>#ref*` surcharge key. Image: `image:<alias>` or `image:<alias>@<resolution>` (USD/image).
   * Music: `music:<alias>` (USD per started minute or per generation). prompt-gen: `llm:<id>#in` /
   * `llm:<id>#out` (USD per M tokens). Default: {}.
   */
  priceOverrides: Record<string, number>;
  /** Sync endpoint base; prompt-gen POSTs `<runUrl>/openrouter/router/openai/v1/chat/completions`. Default: "https://fal.run". */
  runUrl: string;
  /** Image model used when `ImageRequest.model` is omitted. Default: "gpt-image-2.5". */
  imageDefaultModel: string;
  /** OpenRouter model id used when `PromptGenRequest.model` is omitted or `"default"`. Default: "anthropic/claude-opus-5.5". */
  llmDefaultModel: string;
  /** Status-check cadence, ms, of the in-process wait of image and music `execute`. Default: 2000. */
  pollIntervalMs: number;
  /** The in-process wait gives up after this many ms (retryable `timeout`); the fal job keeps running and stays adoptable through `poll`. Default: 900_000. */
  jobTimeoutMs: number;
  /** JSONL request log path, relative to the working directory: one line per billable request of every task. "" = off. Default: "". */
  requestLog: string;
};

export type State = {
  /** Effective price table of every task (bundled prices merged with config.priceOverrides), computed once at first use. */
  prices: Record<string, number> | null;
  /**
   * fal storage URLs of files uploaded by this process, keyed `storage:<mime>:<sha256 of the bytes>`,
   * shared by every task. Only storage URLs are kept, never a data-URI fallback. Kept for the life of
   * the process: `app.stop()` does not clear it.
   */
  uploads: Map<string, string>;
  /**
   * Whether the request log already warned `fal:request-log:failed`. Set by the first failed
   * write, shared by every task's log, so a broken path warns once per plugin instance.
   */
  requestLogWarned: boolean;
};

export type FalInfo = {
  /** Always "fal". */
  provider: "fal";
  /** Whether the configured key env var is present. */
  configured: boolean;
  /** Accepted model aliases, in catalog order. */
  models: string[];
};

export type FalTask = "video" | "image" | "prompt-gen" | "music" | "sfx" | "sprite";

export type FalModelInfo =
  | { id: string; price: { inputPerM: number; outputPerM: number } }
  | { id: string; price: { usd: number; per: "second" | "image" | "minute" | "generation" } };

export type LocalFile = {
  /** Path to the file bytes. */
  path: string;
  /** MIME type of the file. */
  mimeType: string;
  /** Content hash of the file bytes. */
  hash: string;
};

export type FalApi = {
  info(): FalInfo;                          // key present (never throws) + the video aliases
  models(task: FalTask): FalModelInfo[];    // no network, no key; throws `[ai] Unknown fal task "x".`
};
// Error classes (values in FalErrors; types under Fal): RetryableProviderError { status?,
// kind?: "timeout"|"network", retryAfterMs? }, TerminalProviderError { status },
// FlaggedProviderError { kind: "content-policy" }; type FalProviderError = their union.
```

```ts
app.fal.models("prompt-gen")[0]; // => { id: "anthropic/claude-opus-5.5", price: { inputPerM: 4, outputPerM: 20 } }
app.fal.models("music"); // => [{ id: "elevenlabs-music-v2.5", price: { usd: 0.8, per: "minute" } }, { id: "stable-audio-2.5", price: { usd: 0.2, per: "generation" } }]
app.fal.models("image")[0]; // => { id: "nano-banana-pro", price: { usd: 0.15, per: "image" } }
app.fal.models("video")[0]; // => { id: "seedance-2.5", price: { usd: 0.473, per: "second" } }
```

Request log (off by default): with `requestLog` set, every billable request (queue
submit of image, music, sfx and sprite, each prompt-gen POST attempt) writes one JSONL line
{ at, task, model, endpoint, requestId | error, prompt, body }; body without its prompt
field, URLs and data URIs cut; never the key or a header. A failed write warns once.
Logs (redacted): fal:video:submitted/done/failed, fal:image:submitted/done/failed,
fal:music:submitted/done/failed, fal:sfx:submitted/done, fal:sprite:submitted/done,
fal:llm:done, fal:llm:partial, fal:llm:retry,
fal:poll:retry, fal:poll:unknown-status, fal:result:unreadable, fal:upload:fallback,
fal:request-log:failed.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
4.19 apimodels — app.apimodels (Complex tier; depends: [registryPlugin])
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Video provider over the apimodels.app task API: Seedance 2.5 and Seedance 2.0 official,
which accept real faces. onInit registers ("video","apimodels"), submit + poll (no
execute; app.video.generate() drives the same loop). Registered after fal and before ark,
so fal stays the default video provider. Emits no events. The job id is JSON
{ taskId, model, assetUsd }, journaled by the runner before it waits: a resume polls the
same task, never pays twice. Lane video/apimodels: 2 concurrent, 20 rpm (framework
default; apimodels documents no limits).

Models (input.model; same aliases as fal's Seedance rows, so an item switches provider
only; any other value → terminal 400). Every alias needs input.image.
- seedance-2.5 (480p, 720p; 4–30 s; USD/s 0.12 / 0.27): image → first_frame_url,
  endImage → last_frame_url, refs refused.
- seedance-2.5-ref (same model, prices): image → reference_image_urls[0]; refs by MIME:
  images (30 with the image), audio (10), video (10); endImage refused.
- seedance-2.0 (API seedance-2.0-official; 480p, 720p, 1080p; 4–15 s; USD/s 0.092 /
  0.197 / 0.492): first and last frame, refs refused.
- seedance-2.0-ref: as 2.5-ref, 9 images with the image.
Defaults seconds 5, aspect "9:16", audio false, resolution 720p. negative is dropped
(debug log apimodels:negative:ignored). input.fromDraft is refused (use ark).

params.assets: the inputs to send as asset://<id> ("image", "endImage", "refs.<n>");
without it every input is an https upload and apimodels registers a refused face by
itself. Lookup per named input: state cache → journal provider record → register
(upload → group "assetGroup", created once per account → POST /assets). Account =
sha256("moku-ai:" + apiKey), first 12 hex. A registration costs `asset` (0.01 USD).

```ts
export type Config = {
  apiKeyEnv: string;      // default "APIMODELS_API_KEY" (read via ctx.env at submit/poll; estimates are key-free)
  baseUrl: string;        // default "https://api.apimodels.app/v1"
  assetGroup: string;     // default "moku-ai"
  timeoutMs: number;      // default 60_000 (one HTTP request)
  priceOverrides: Record<string, number>; // "<alias>@<resolution>" (USD/s) or "asset"; default {}
};
export type ApimodelsInfo = { provider: "apimodels"; configured: boolean; models: string[] };
export type ApimodelsApi = { info(): ApimodelsInfo };  // no network call
// Error classes (values in ApimodelsErrors; types under Apimodels): RetryableProviderError,
// TerminalProviderError, FlaggedProviderError; type ApimodelsProviderError = their union.
```

Poll: pending/processing → pending; completed → download resultUrls[0] (lives 7 days)
→ done video, cost = settled USD credits from GET /records/<taskId> + assetUsd, else the
table price + assetUsd; CONTENT_MODERATION → flagged; a dead result or a stale asset id
→ retryable 503 kind "resubmit" (the runner submits anew); other failures → retryable
503 or terminal 400 per the README table.
Missing key: `[ai] apimodels needs an API key.\n  Set APIMODELS_API_KEY (or the env var
named by apimodels.apiKeyEnv).`
Logs (redacted): apimodels:video:submitted/done/failed, apimodels:asset:registered,
apimodels:asset:stale, apimodels:asset-group:stale, apimodels:journal:closed,
apimodels:negative:ignored, apimodels:poll:unknown-state, apimodels:records:unavailable,
apimodels:result:unreadable. Full reference: src/plugins/apimodels/README.md.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
4.20 sfx — app.sfx (Standard tier; depends: [registryPlugin]; stateless)
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Owns the "sfx" task contract: short sound effects from a text prompt, always mp3. A
handler has `estimate` + `execute`; there is no job form. `model` is REQUIRED (the
runner hashes the input as written). The ONE audited cast is behind `isSfxHandler`.
Providers: elevenlabs (default; eleven_text_to_sound_v2) and fal (elevenlabs-sfx-v2).

```ts
export type SfxRequest = {
  prompt: string;
  model: string;               // required, part of the artifact key
  durationMs?: number;         // omitted → the provider picks the length
  promptInfluence?: number;    // 0..1
  loop?: boolean;
  params?: Record<string, unknown>;
};
export type SfxResult = { audio: Uint8Array; mimeType: "audio/mpeg"; costUsd: number; meta?: Record<string, unknown> };
export type SfxHandler = {
  estimate(request: SfxRequest): { usd: number };
  execute(request: SfxRequest, opts: { signal?: AbortSignal }): Promise<SfxResult>;
};
export type SfxApi = {
  generate(request: SfxRequest, opts?: { provider?: string; signal?: AbortSignal }): Promise<SfxResult>;
  estimate(request: SfxRequest, opts?: { provider?: string }): { usd: number };
  providers(): string[];
};
```

```yaml
- task: sfx
  id: coin-pickup
  input: { model: "eleven_text_to_sound_v2", prompt: "Coin pickup, bright 8-bit chime.", durationMs: 600 }
```

Errors: `[ai] No sfx provider named "<name>" is registered.\n  Available: <list or "none">.`

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
4.21 sprite — app.sprite (Standard tier; depends: [registryPlugin]; stateless)
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Owns the "sprite" task contract: cut an existing image into a transparent RGBA PNG
(matte, trim to alpha bounds, resize, padding). A sprite item `$ref`s an image item;
changing sprite options re-cuts the stored image and never regenerates it. `model` is
REQUIRED. Module exports `isSpriteHandler` and `processSprite(png, options)` (the pure
sharp pixel step every provider runs after its matte). Provider: fal (default).
An item id may end with a nine-slice hint `<label>{nine=l,t,r,b}` (whole pixels); it
stays in the exported file name. Any other brace in an id fails at load.

```ts
export type SpriteFile = { path: string; mimeType: string; hash: string };
export type SpriteRequest = {
  source: SpriteFile;          // the runner resolves { $ref } / { $file } into this
  model: string;               // "birefnet"; "none" = already transparent
  trim?: boolean;              // default true
  padding?: number;            // px, default 0; with size, inside it (16x16 + padding 2 = 12x12 picture, 2 px border)
  size?: { width: number; height: number };   // default: size after trim
  fit?: "contain" | "cover" | "fill";         // default "contain" (transparent letterbox)
  pixelArt?: boolean;          // nearest-neighbour; default false (lanczos3)
  alphaThreshold?: number;     // 0..255, default 8
  params?: Record<string, unknown>;
};
export type SpriteResult = { image: Uint8Array; mimeType: "image/png"; costUsd: number; meta?: Record<string, unknown> };
export type SpriteHandler = {
  estimate(request: SpriteRequest): { usd: number };   // reads model only
  execute(request: SpriteRequest, opts: { signal?: AbortSignal }): Promise<SpriteResult>;
};
export type SpriteApi = {
  generate(request: SpriteRequest, opts?: { provider?: string; signal?: AbortSignal }): Promise<SpriteResult>;
  estimate(request: SpriteRequest, opts?: { provider?: string }): { usd: number };
  providers(): string[];
};
```

```yaml
- task: image
  id: button-raw
  input: { prompt: "Wooden game UI button, flat colour background.", aspect: "1:1" }
- task: sprite
  id: "button{nine=12,12,12,12}"
  input: { model: "birefnet", source: { $ref: button-raw }, size: { width: 128, height: 64 }, padding: 2 }
```

Errors: `[ai] No sprite provider named "<name>" is registered.\n  Available: <list or "none">.`
`[ai] Sprite is empty after background removal.\n  Check the source image or lower alphaThreshold.`
`[ai] Sprite padding <p> leaves no room inside <w>x<h>.\n  Lower padding or raise size.`

================================================================================
5. COMPLETE EVENT CATALOG
================================================================================

Plugin-bus events (declared ONLY by runner; every other plugin declares none):

| Event            | Payload                                                              | When |
|------------------|----------------------------------------------------------------------|------|
| run:progress     | { runId: string; total: number; done: number; failed: number; flagged: number; spendUsd: number } | coalesced, ≤1 per 500ms |
| run:done         | { runId: string; totals: RunTotals }                                  | run completed |
| run:failed       | { runId: string; error: string }                                      | unrecoverable run error |
| run:budget-stop  | { runId: string; spendUsd: number; maxCostUsd: number }               | budget ceiling; run drained |
| run:paused       | { runId: string; drained: number }                                    | clean pause completed |

Subscription: a plugin declares `depends: [runnerPlugin]` and a `hooks` map (typed via
dependency events). There is NO app.on. Hook dispatch is sequential-await — which is
exactly why per-item events are kept off the bus.

```ts
const watcher = createPlugin("watcher", {
  depends: [runnerPlugin],
  hooks: ctx => ({
    "run:progress": payload => ctx.log.info("progress", payload),
    "run:budget-stop": ({ runId, spendUsd, maxCostUsd }) =>
      ctx.log.warn("budget stop", { runId, spendUsd, maxCostUsd })
  })
});
```

Per-item stream records — app.runner.events(opts?), AsyncIterable<RunEvent>, active runs only
(closed empty stream otherwise). Every record also carries runId:

| Record            | Fields                                | When |
|-------------------|----------------------------------------|------|
| item:queued       | itemId, task, provider                 | item enters the pipeline |
| item:dispatching  | itemId                                 | passed the atomic gate |
| item:done         | itemId, costUsd, contentHash, contentHashes? | artifact stored + committed |
| item:retry        | itemId, errorClass, attempt            | retryable failure; re-queued with backoff |
| item:failed       | itemId, label, errorClass, message?    | terminal failure |
| item:flagged      | itemId, message?                       | content policy (terminal) |
| overflow          | dropped                                | buffer overflowed; oldest item records coalesced |
| progress          | totals                                 | coalesced totals (latest unconsumed wins) |
| terminal          | status, totals                         | ALWAYS the last record delivered |

Structured log events (ctx.log; diagnostics, not bus events): runner:stale-item,
elevenlabs:voiceover:done/failed, openai:tts:done/failed, openai:translate:done/failed,
openai:prompt-gen:done/failed, codex:image:done, codex:prompt-gen:done,
claude:prompt-gen:done, ark:video:submitted/done/failed, ark:asset:group-created
(warn), ark:asset:registered, ark:asset:refused (warn), ark:negative:ignored (warn),
fal:video|image|music:submitted/done/failed, fal:sfx|sprite:submitted/done,
fal:llm:done/partial/retry, fal:poll:retry,
fal:poll:unknown-status, fal:result:unreadable, fal:upload:fallback,
fal:request-log:failed, apimodels:video:submitted/done/failed, apimodels:asset:registered
(see §4.19 for the rest).

================================================================================
6. CONFIG SCHEMA — EVERY FIELD
================================================================================

Global framework Config: {} (empty, ratified). Per-plugin (defaults shipped in each
plugin's index.ts; override REGULAR plugins via createApp({ pluginConfigs }) or, for the
`moku` bin, a moku.config.ts `export default defineConfig({ pluginConfigs })`):

journal (core — createCore-level only):
  path: string = ".moku/journal.db"            — journal DB file; parents created on start
  checkpointIntervalMs: number = 30_000        — wal_checkpoint(TRUNCATE) cadence (unref'd)
  busyTimeoutMs: number = 5000                 — SQLite busy_timeout (also for readSnapshot conns)

store (core — createCore-level only):
  dir: string = ".moku/store"                  — CAS root (gitignored)
  algo: "sha256" = "sha256"                    — fixed at M0

limits (core — createCore-level only):
  defaults.rpm: number = 60                    — requests/minute per lane (bucket capacity)
  defaults.concurrency: number = 4             — in-flight ceiling per lane
  defaults.breakerThreshold: number = 5        — consecutive retryable failures to open
  defaults.breakerCooldownMs: number = 30_000  — open duration before half-open probe
  lanes: Record<string, Partial<LaneConfig>> = {} — exact-lane or "{task}/{provider}" prefix overrides.
    The framework sets { "video/apimodels": { concurrency: 2, rpm: 20 },
    "video/ark": { concurrency: 3, rpm: 180 } } in createCore; a lanes override replaces
    the whole map.

registry: no config.

buildfile:
  defaultGlob: string = "**/*.moku.yaml"       — used when loadGlob gets no pattern
  schemaPath: string = ".moku/build.schema.json" — where moku new writes the JSON Schema

runner:
  maxAttempts: number = 3                      — per-item retry ceiling (build defaults.maxAttempts overrides)
  retryBaseMs: number = 1000                   — backoff base (exponential, jittered 50–100%)
  eventBufferSize: number = 10_000             — events() per-consumer buffer
  pollIntervalMs: number = 5000                — delay between two polls of an async provider job
  jobTimeoutMs: number = 1_800_000             — a job still pending after this is expired; the next
                                                 attempt polls it again before it submits
  maxActiveRuns: number = 1                    — runs driven at once in this process

voiceover:
  defaultProvider: string = "elevenlabs"
  defaultFormat: "mp3" | "wav" | "ogg" = "mp3"

translate:
  defaultProvider: string = "openai"

promptGen:
  defaultProvider: string = "openai"
  fallback: string[] = []                      — providers tried in order when the chosen one is unavailable

image:
  defaultProvider: string = "codex"

video:
  defaultProvider: string = "fal"
  pollIntervalMs: number = 5000                — facade poll cadence (the runner uses runner.pollIntervalMs)

elevenlabs:
  apiKeyEnv: string = "ELEVENLABS_API_KEY"
  baseUrl: string = "https://api.elevenlabs.io"
  defaultModel: string = "eleven_multilingual_v2"
  timeoutMs: number = 60_000
  priceOverrides: Record<string, number> = {}  — USD/char by model; sfx:<model>#second / sfx:<model>#auto

openai:
  apiKeyEnv: string = "OPENAI_API_KEY"
  baseUrl?: string = undefined                 — SDK default endpoint when omitted
  models: { tts: string; chat: string } = { tts: "gpt-4o-mini-tts", chat: "gpt-4o-mini" }
  timeoutMs: number = 60_000
  priceOverrides: Record<string, { inputPerM?: number; outputPerM?: number; ttsPerMChars?: number }> = {}

codex:
  bin: string = "codex"                        — bare name looked up on PATH, or a path
  model: string = "gpt-6-astra"                — image model when a request names none
  reasoningEffort: string = "low"              — sent as -c model_reasoning_effort="<effort>"
  timeoutMs: number = 600_000                  — kill the CLI after this long
  workDir: string = ".moku/tmp"                — per-call temp dirs, against the cwd; "" = os.tmpdir()
  priceOverrides: Record<string, number> = {}  — USD per image by model, merged over the bundled table
  textModel: string = ""                       — prompt-gen model when none maps; "" leaves -m out
  modelMap: Record<string, string> = {}        — exact request-model id → codex model, checked first

claude:
  bin: string = "claude"                       — bare name looked up on PATH, or a path
  textModel: string = ""                       — model when mapping gives none; "" = no --model
  modelMap: Record<string, string> = {}        — exact request-model id → claude model, checked first
  timeoutMs: number = 600_000                  — kill the CLI (SIGTERM) after this long
  workDir: string = ""                         — per-call temp dirs; "" = os.tmpdir() (outside the repo)

music:
  defaultProvider: string = "fal"
  pollIntervalMs: number = 5000                — facade poll cadence (the runner uses runner.pollIntervalMs)

sfx:
  defaultProvider: string = "elevenlabs"

sprite:
  defaultProvider: string = "fal"

fal:
  apiKeyEnv: string = "FAL_KEY"
  queueUrl: string = "https://queue.fal.run"   — submit is POST <queueUrl>/<endpoint> (video, image, music, sfx, sprite)
  uploadUrl: string = "https://rest.alpha.fal.ai/storage/upload/initiate?storage_type=fal-cdn-v3"
  upload: "storage" | "data-uri" = "storage"   — storage falls back to a data URI when the upload fails
  timeoutMs: number = 60_000                   — one HTTP request
  priceOverrides: Record<string, number> = {}  — video <alias>; image:<alias>; music:<alias>; sfx:<alias>; sprite:<alias>; llm:<id>#in / #out
  runUrl: string = "https://fal.run"           — sync base for prompt-gen
  imageDefaultModel: string = "gpt-image-2.5"
  llmDefaultModel: string = "anthropic/claude-opus-5.5"
  pollIntervalMs: number = 2000                 — in-process wait of image, music, sfx and sprite execute
  jobTimeoutMs: number = 900_000               — that wait gives up (retryable timeout); the job stays adoptable
  requestLog: string = ""                      — JSONL path; off when ""

asset:
  defaultProvider: string = "ark"
  pollIntervalMs: number = 3000                — facade poll cadence (Ark GetAsset guidance)

apimodels:
  apiKeyEnv: string = "APIMODELS_API_KEY"
  baseUrl: string = "https://api.apimodels.app/v1"
  assetGroup: string = "moku-ai"               — asset group created once per account
  timeoutMs: number = 60_000                   — one HTTP request
  priceOverrides: Record<string, number> = {}  — "<alias>@<resolution>" (USD/s) or "asset"

ark:
  region: "intl" | "cn" = "intl"               — BytePlus ModelArk or Volcengine Ark
  apiKeyEnv: string = "ARK_API_KEY"            — Bearer key, video tasks
  accessKeyEnv: string = "ARK_ACCESS_KEY"      — signed asset API
  secretKeyEnv: string = "ARK_SECRET_KEY"
  baseUrl: string | null = null                — null = region data plane
  controlUrl: string | null = null             — null = region control plane
  groupId: string | null = null                — null = create one per process, log its id (max 50 per account)
  groupName: string = "moku-ai"
  timeoutMs: number = 60_000
  downloadTimeoutMs: number = 300_000          — one clip or image download
  priceOverrides: Record<string, number> = {}  — USD per 1M output tokens by model id
  cnyPerUsd: number = 7.1

compose:
  provider: string = "openai"
  maxRepairAttempts: number = 2                — additional attempts; total = 1 + this

cli:
  plain: boolean = false                       — auto-true when !TTY or NO_COLOR (via ctx.env)

Environment variables: ELEVENLABS_API_KEY, OPENAI_API_KEY, FAL_KEY, APIMODELS_API_KEY,
ARK_API_KEY, ARK_ACCESS_KEY, ARK_SECRET_KEY (names configurable via apiKeyEnv / accessKeyEnv /
secretKeyEnv; read via ctx.env at execute time only), PATH (codex / claude find their CLI),
NO_COLOR (CLI plain mode). Sources: the shell first, then .env.local in the cwd.

================================================================================
7. COMPLETE USAGE EXAMPLES
================================================================================

7.1 Durable run with budget, clean pause, live stream, and resume:

```ts
import { createApp } from "@moku-labs/ai";

const app = createApp({});
await app.start();

const controller = new AbortController();
process.on("SIGINT", () => controller.abort());

const { totalUsd } = await app.runner.estimate({ files: "voice/*.moku.yaml" });
const runPromise = app.runner.run(
  { files: "voice/*.moku.yaml", maxCostUsd: totalUsd * 1.2 },
  { signal: controller.signal }
);

for await (const event of app.runner.events()) {
  if (event.type === "item:done") report(event.itemId, event.costUsd);
  if (event.type === "item:retry") warn(event.itemId, event.errorClass, event.attempt);
  if (event.type === "terminal") break;
}

const result = await runPromise;
if (result.status === "paused") {
  await app.runner.resume({ runId: result.runId }); // done items never re-billed
}
await app.stop();
```

7.2 One-off facades (NOT journaled — scripts/tests/experiments only):

```ts
const { configured } = app.elevenlabs.info();
if (!configured) throw new Error("Export ELEVENLABS_API_KEY first.");

const { usd } = app.voiceover.estimate({ text: "Welcome!", voice: "21m00Tcm4TlvDq8ikWAM" });
const speech = await app.voiceover.generate(
  { text: "Welcome!", voice: "21m00Tcm4TlvDq8ikWAM", format: "ogg" },
  { provider: "elevenlabs" }
);
await Bun.write("welcome.ogg", speech.audio);

const translated = await app.translate.generate({ text: "Welcome!", targetLang: "ja" });
const track = await app.music.generate(
  { prompt: "tense synth pulse", model: "elevenlabs-music-v2.5", lengthMs: 60_000 },
  { provider: "fal" }
);
await Bun.write("teaser.mp3", track.audio);
const coin = await app.sfx.generate({ prompt: "coin pickup, bright chime", model: "eleven_text_to_sound_v2", durationMs: 600 });
await Bun.write("coin-pickup.mp3", coin.audio);
const tagline = await app.promptGen.generate(
  { prompt: "One-line tagline for a durable AI build system.", temperature: 0.7 },
  { provider: "openai" }
);
```

7.3 Natural language → build file → run (compose + cli split: compose produces text,
the caller persists it):

```ts
const { spec, text, costUsd } = await app.compose.compose({
  prompt: "Narrate a greeting in English, then translate it to Spanish.",
  emit: "build",
  name: "greeting"
});
await Bun.write("greeting.moku.yaml", text);
const result = await app.runner.run({ files: "greeting.moku.yaml", maxCostUsd: 1 });
```

7.4 Build files — YAML, NDJSON items, and typed TS:

```yaml
# yaml-language-server: $schema=.moku/build.schema.json
$schema: .moku/build.schema.json
version: 1
name: "launch-assets"
defaults: { provider: elevenlabs, maxAttempts: 3 }
items:
  - task: voiceover
    id: intro-line
    input: { text: "Hello, world!", voice: "en-US-1" }
  - task: translate
    provider: openai
    input: { text: "Hello, world!", targetLang: "es" }
    params: { formality: high }        # part of the planning key
itemsFrom: extra-items.ndjson          # one BuildItem JSON object per line
```

```ts
// build.moku.ts — compile({ path: "build.moku.ts" }) imports the default export
import { defineBuild } from "@moku-labs/ai";
export default defineBuild({
  version: 1,
  name: "demo",
  items: [{ task: "voiceover", input: { text: "Hello, world!", voice: "en-US-1" } }]
});
```

7.5 Status from a second process (safe — readSnapshot opens its own short-lived
connection against the shared WAL journal file):

```ts
const report = app.runner.status();            // { runId, status, totals, updatedAt }
// or: moku status --follow
```

7.6 Direct journal/store/limits use from a custom plugin (full item lifecycle):

```ts
import { createPlugin } from "@moku-labs/ai";

export const myPipelinePlugin = createPlugin("myPipeline", {
  api: ctx => ({
    async produceOne() {
      const run = ctx.journal.openRun({ glob: "assets/*.yaml", maxCostUsd: 10 });
      const [item] = ctx.journal.insertItems(run.id, [{
        planningKey: ctx.store.hashOf(new TextEncoder().encode("intent")),
        buildFile: "assets/one.yaml", task: "voiceover", provider: "elevenlabs",
        packVersion: null, estimatedCostUsd: 0.4
      }]);

      const gate = ctx.journal.gateToDispatching(item.id);
      if (!gate.ok) return ctx.log.warn("blocked", { reason: gate.reason }); // "budget" | "duplicate"

      const lane = "voiceover/elevenlabs/default";
      const { release } = await ctx.limits.acquire(lane);
      const attemptId = ctx.journal.recordAttempt(item.id, {
        provider: "elevenlabs", account: "default", startedAt: Date.now()
      });
      try {
        const body = await callProvider();
        const { hash } = await ctx.store.put(body);      // bytes FIRST
        ctx.limits.reportOutcome(lane, "ok");
        ctx.journal.finishAttempt(attemptId, { endedAt: Date.now(), outcome: "done", costUsd: 0.2 });
        ctx.journal.commitDone(item.id, { actualCostUsd: 0.2, artifactKey: hash, contentHash: hash });
        ctx.journal.setRunStatus(run.id, "done");
      } catch {
        ctx.limits.reportOutcome(lane, "retryable-error");
        ctx.journal.finishAttempt(attemptId, {
          endedAt: Date.now(), outcome: "retryable-error", errorClass: "http-5xx"
        });
        ctx.journal.markFailed(item.id, { errorClass: "http-5xx", terminal: false });
      } finally {
        release();
      }
    }
  })
});
```

7.7 Programmatic CLI dispatch:

```ts
import { Cli, createApp } from "@moku-labs/ai";
const app = createApp({ pluginConfigs: { cli: { plain: true } } });
await app.start();
const code = await app.cli.dispatch(["validate"]);
if (code !== Cli.EXIT_CODES.ok) { /* handle */ }
await app.stop();
```

7.8 Project config for the `moku` bin, and a flat export:

```ts
// moku.config.ts in the project root (or pass --config <path> on any command)
import { defineConfig } from "@moku-labs/ai";
import { myProvider } from "./plugins/my-provider";

export default defineConfig({
  plugins: [myProvider],
  pluginConfigs: { ark: { region: "cn" }, fal: { upload: "data-uri" } }
});
```

```sh
moku run --config configs/cn.ts --max-cost 5   # --config is stripped before dispatch
moku export --out assets/icons --flat          # assets/icons/<label>.<ext>, no <build>/ folder
```

```ts
const icons = await app.runner.export({ outDir: "assets/icons", flat: true });
// icons.files[0].path: "/repo/assets/icons/sword.png"
// a second build with a "sword" label: icons.skipped is ["sword"], the first file is kept
```

================================================================================
8. ERROR HANDLING PATTERNS
================================================================================

All framework errors are plain Error subclasses at M0 (no custom error hierarchy
beyond the provider classes). Messages follow the pinned two-line format:
"[ai] <what happened>.\n  <how to fix it>."

Pattern 1 — provider error taxonomy (instanceof, per provider `<Provider>Errors` value
namespace; the `Elevenlabs.*` names are types only and cannot be used with instanceof):

```ts
import { ElevenlabsErrors } from "@moku-labs/ai";
try {
  await app.voiceover.generate({ text: "Hi", voice: "21m00Tcm4TlvDq8ikWAM" });
} catch (error) {
  if (error instanceof ElevenlabsErrors.RetryableProviderError) {
    // transient: 5xx / 429 / timeout / network — error.status, error.kind, error.retryAfterMs
  } else if (error instanceof ElevenlabsErrors.FlaggedProviderError) {
    // content policy — do not re-queue
  } else if (error instanceof ElevenlabsErrors.TerminalProviderError) {
    // deterministic 4xx — error.status
  } else throw error;
}
```

Pattern 2 — structural classification (how the runner does it; no class imports).
Provider errors carry ProviderErrorHint fields read by shape: `status?: number`,
`kind?: "timeout" | "network" | "content-policy" | "resubmit" | "invalid-request" | "local-failure"`, `publicMessage?: string` (kind overrides status),
`retryAfterMs?: number`. An error with no hint classifies as "unknown" (terminal: a
programming error never re-runs a paid job); tag real transport failures kind "network".
Custom providers steer retry behavior by attaching these fields to thrown errors.

Pattern 3 — breaker-open (tag, not message):

```ts
try {
  const { release } = await ctx.limits.acquire(lane);
  // ... release() in finally
} catch (error) {
  if ((error as { reason?: string }).reason === "breaker-open") return; // skip / fail over
  throw error;
}
```

Pattern 4 — gate results are values, not throws:
`gateToDispatching` returns { ok: false, reason: "budget" | "duplicate" } — branch,
don't catch. Run-level failures also resolve (RunResult.status "failed") rather than
reject; run()/resume() throw only for caller mistakes (run already active, unknown
runId, no resumable run).

Pattern 5 — aborts are not errors. A caller-initiated AbortSignal abort propagates
unchanged (never reclassified, never breaker-reported); the runner turns it into
{ status: "paused" } after draining in-flight items.

Pinned message catalog (verbatim, interpolations in <>):
- [ai] Journal is not open.\n  Call app.start() before using the journal.
- [ai] Store object not found for hash <hash>.
- [ai] Store integrity check failed for <hash>.
- [ai] Provider "<provider>" is already registered for task "<task>".\n  Register each task/provider pair exactly once.
- [ai] Build file "<label>" is invalid.\n  <path>: <message>.
- [ai] No build files matched "<pattern>".\n  Run "moku new" to create one.
- [ai] No voiceover provider named "<name>" is registered.\n  Available: <list or "none">.
  (same shape for translate / prompt-gen)
- [ai] Registered translate provider "<name>" does not implement TranslateHandler.\n  It must expose estimate() and execute() functions.
  (same shape per task contract)
- [ai] ELEVENLABS_API_KEY is not set.\n  Export it or set config.apiKeyEnv to the variable that holds your key.
- [ai] OPENAI_API_KEY is not set.\n  Export it or set config.apiKeyEnv to the variable that holds your key.
- [ai] Compose could not produce a valid build file after <n> attempts.\n  Refine the prompt or write the build file manually with "moku new".
- [ai] No asset provider named "<name>" is registered.\n  Available: <list or "none">.
- [ai] No music provider named "<name>" is registered.\n  Available: <list or "none">.
  (same shape for sfx / sprite)
- [ai] No image provider named "<name>" is registered.\n  Available: <list or "none">.  (also for a registered value that is not an ImageHandler)
- [ai] No video provider named "<name>" is registered.\n  Available: <list or "none">.  (also for a registered value that is not a VideoHandler)
- [ai] No price for codex model "<model>".\n  Add it to codex priceOverrides.
- [ai] Codex CLI not found: <bin>.\n  Install codex or set codex.bin.  (PromptGenUnavailableError "missing")
- [ai] Codex CLI is not logged in.\n  Run codex login, or use another provider.  (PromptGenUnavailableError "auth")
- [ai] Codex CLI hit its plan or rate limit.\n  Wait for the reset, or use another provider.  (PromptGenUnavailableError "limit")
- [ai] Codex CLI could not start: <code or message>.\n  Check that codex.bin is an executable file.
- [ai] Codex exited with <code <n> | signal <name>>[: <detail>].\n  Run the same codex exec by hand to see the full output.  (TerminalProviderError)
- [ai] Codex timed out after <ms> ms.\n  Raise codex.timeoutMs or retry the build.  (RetryableProviderError "timeout")
- [ai] Codex finished without writing an image.\n  Check that the codex model can generate images, then retry.
- [ai] Codex wrote no answer.\n  Run the same codex exec by hand to see the full output.  (TerminalProviderError)
- [ai] Codex answer does not match params.responseSchema.\n  <path>: <issue>.  (or second line "The answer is not valid JSON."; TerminalProviderError)
- [ai] Codex params.images must be image files.\n  Pass { path, mimeType, hash } for every image.
- [ai] Codex params.responseSchema must be a JSON schema object.\n  Pass the schema as a plain object.
- [ai] Codex params.reasoning must be off, low, medium or high.\n  Got "<value>".
- [ai] Claude CLI not found: <bin>.\n  Install Claude Code or set claude.bin.  (PromptGenUnavailableError "missing")
- [ai] Claude CLI is not logged in.\n  Run claude and /login, or use another provider.  (PromptGenUnavailableError "auth")
- [ai] Claude CLI hit its plan or rate limit.\n  Wait for the reset, or use another provider.  (PromptGenUnavailableError "limit")
- [ai] Claude CLI could not start: <code or message>.\n  Check that claude.bin is an executable file.
- [ai] Claude returned an error: <detail>.\n  Run the same claude -p by hand to see the full output.  (TerminalProviderError)
- [ai] Claude exited with <code <n> | signal <name>>[: <last stderr line>].\n  Run the same claude -p by hand to see the full output.  (TerminalProviderError)
- [ai] Claude printed no JSON result.\n  Run the same claude -p by hand to see the full output.  (TerminalProviderError)
- [ai] Claude wrote no answer.\n  Run the same claude -p by hand to see the full output.  (TerminalProviderError)
- [ai] Claude timed out after <ms> ms.\n  Raise claude.timeoutMs or retry the build.  (RetryableProviderError "timeout")
- [ai] Claude answer does not match params.responseSchema.\n  <path>: <issue>.  (or second line "The answer is not valid JSON."; TerminalProviderError)
- [ai] Claude params.images must be image files.\n  Pass { path, mimeType, hash } for every image.
- [ai] Claude params.responseSchema must be a JSON schema object.\n  Pass the schema as a plain object.
- [ai] Claude params.reasoning must be off, low, medium or high.\n  Got "<value>".
- [ai] Unknown fal task "<task>".\n  Use one of: video, image, prompt-gen, music, sfx, sprite.
- [ai] No price for fal <task> model "<id>".\n  Add it to fal.priceOverrides.  (image, music, sfx, sprite, prompt-gen)
- [ai] Not an asset record: <reason>.\n  Expected JSON with assetId, provider, account, groupId, registeredAt.
- [ai] ark refused an image with a face: <code>.\n  Use a Seedream image made by provider ark on this account, bytes unchanged, or an asset item.
- [ai] ark refused asset "<name>": <reason>.\n  Items that use it will not run.
- [ai] ark asset "<assetId>" is <Status>.\n  Bump params.generation on its asset item to register again.
- [ai] ark CreateAsset needs a public https url.\n  Pass input.url with the same bytes as input.image.
- [ai] Tool call "<name>" has arguments that are not JSON.\n  The model sent: <first 200 chars>.  (ToolArgumentsError)
- [ai] <Claude|Codex|OpenAI> prompt-gen does not support messages or tools.\n  Use the fal provider for tool calling.  (PromptGenUnavailableError "unsupported")
- [ai] fal image model "gpt-image-2.5" cannot write a transparent jpeg.\n  Use output_format "png" or "webp".  (TerminalProviderError 400)
- [ai] apimodels needs an API key.\n  Set APIMODELS_API_KEY (or the env var named by apimodels.apiKeyEnv).
- [ai] Could not load <path>.\n  <reason>  (moku bin, exit 3)
- [ai] --config needs a file path.\n  Pass --config <path> or --config=<path>.  (moku bin, exit 3)

================================================================================
9. DEPENDENCY GRAPH + INITIALIZATION ORDER
================================================================================

Core plugins (Layer 1, before all regular plugins):
  log → env → journal → store → limits          (no inter-dependencies; injected as ctx.*)

Regular plugins (Layer 2 registration order in src/index.ts — every plugin after
everything it depends on):

  1. registry      (deps: none)   Nano
  2. buildfile     (deps: none)   Standard
  3. runner        (deps: registry, buildfile)          Complex
  4. voiceover     (deps: registry)                      Standard
  5. translate     (deps: registry)                      Standard
  6. promptGen     (deps: registry)                      Standard
  7. image         (deps: registry)                      Standard
  8. video         (deps: registry)                      Standard
  9. music         (deps: registry)                      Standard
 10. sfx           (deps: registry)                      Standard
 11. sprite        (deps: registry)                      Standard
 12. asset         (deps: registry)                      Standard
 13. elevenlabs    (deps: registry) — onInit registers ("voiceover","elevenlabs"),
                    ("sfx","elevenlabs")                                             Complex
 14. openai        (deps: registry) — onInit registers ("voiceover","openai"),
                    ("translate","openai"), ("prompt-gen","openai")                  Complex
 15. codex         (deps: registry) — ("image","codex"), ("prompt-gen","codex")     Complex
 16. claude        (deps: registry) — ("prompt-gen","claude")                       Complex
 17. fal           (deps: registry) — ("video","fal"), ("image","fal"),
                    ("prompt-gen","fal"), ("music","fal"), ("sfx","fal"),
                    ("sprite","fal")                                                 Complex
 18. apimodels     (deps: registry) — ("video","apimodels")                         Complex
 19. ark           (deps: registry) — ("video","ark"), ("asset","ark"),
                    ("image","ark")                                                  Complex
 20. compose       (deps: buildfile, promptGen)          Standard
 21. cli           (deps: runner, buildfile, compose)    Complex

ASCII graph (A --> B means A depends on B):

  runner ----> registry        runner ----> buildfile
  voiceover, translate, promptGen, image, video, music, sfx, sprite, asset -> registry
  elevenlabs, openai, codex, claude, fal, apimodels, ark ---------------> registry
  compose ---> buildfile       compose ---> promptGen
  cli -------> runner          cli --------> buildfile    cli --------> compose

Provider registration happens in onInit, so by the time app.start() resolves every
task facade sees its providers. Registration order makes elevenlabs the first (and
therefore default) voiceover provider; openai is the only translate/prompt-gen
provider at M0. Wave history: W1 registry+buildfile · W2 runner+voiceover+translate+
promptGen · W3 elevenlabs+openai+compose · W4 cli.

Later waves add image, video, codex and fal, then W5 asset (registered after video)
and W6 ark (registered after fal, before compose — fal stays the first, default video
provider; ark is the only asset provider). claude registers after codex; apimodels
registers after fal and before ark (a second video provider; fal stays the default). music is registered after video and before
asset; fal registers ("music","fal"), so fal is the default (and only) music provider.
sfx and sprite are registered right after music. elevenlabs registers ("sfx","elevenlabs")
before fal registers ("sfx","fal"), so elevenlabs is the default sfx provider; fal is the
only sprite provider.

================================================================================
10. EXTENSION PATTERNS
================================================================================

10.1 Custom provider for an existing task (most common):

```ts
import { createApp, createPlugin, registryPlugin } from "@moku-labs/ai";
import type { Voiceover } from "@moku-labs/ai";

const handler: Voiceover.VoiceoverHandler = {
  estimate: request => ({ usd: request.text.length * 0.00003 }),
  execute: async (request, { signal }) => ({
    audio: await acmeSynthesize(request.text, request.voice, signal),
    mimeType: "audio/mpeg",
    costUsd: request.text.length * 0.00003
  })
};

export const acmeTtsPlugin = createPlugin("acmeTts", {
  depends: [registryPlugin],
  onInit: ctx => {
    ctx.require(registryPlugin).register("voiceover", "acme", handler);
  }
});

const app = createApp({
  plugins: [acmeTtsPlugin],
  pluginConfigs: { voiceover: { defaultProvider: "acme", defaultFormat: "mp3" } }
});
```

Rules: implement the task's contract type; register in onInit under the task key;
throw errors carrying ProviderErrorHint fields (status/kind/retryAfterMs) so the
runner's retry taxonomy classifies them; never echo request text in messages/meta/logs.

10.2 Custom TASK (open task set — a stated product requirement). Define a contract,
register handlers under a new task key, and build files can use it immediately (the
runner validates the handler shape at dispatch, not the task name at compile):

```ts
import { createPlugin, registryPlugin } from "@moku-labs/ai";

type StickerRequest = { prompt: string; size?: string };
type StickerHandler = {
  estimate(request: StickerRequest): { usd: number };
  execute(request: StickerRequest, opts: { signal?: AbortSignal }):
    Promise<{ body: Uint8Array; mimeType: string; costUsd: number }>;
    // The runner calls it with the flat request ({ ...input, params }) and stores
    // body | audio | image | video | text bytes in the CAS with the mime type.
};

const stickerHandler: StickerHandler = {
  estimate: () => ({ usd: 0.04 }),
  execute: async request => ({ body: await renderPng(request), mimeType: "image/png", costUsd: 0.04 })
};

export const stickerProviderPlugin = createPlugin("stickerProvider", {
  depends: [registryPlugin],
  onInit: ctx => ctx.require(registryPlugin).register("sticker", "acme", stickerHandler)
});
```

```yaml
items:
  - task: sticker
    input: { prompt: "a neon city skyline", size: "1024x1024" }
```

The built-in `image` (codex, fal, ark), `video` (fal, apimodels, ark), `music` (fal),
`asset` (ark), `sfx` (elevenlabs, fal) and `sprite` (fal) tasks follow the same pattern;
a video, music or asset handler exposes `submit` + `poll` so the provider job id is
journaled.

10.3 Event-consumer plugin (bus subscription — the only way; no app.on):

```ts
import { createPlugin, runnerPlugin } from "@moku-labs/ai";

export const metricsPlugin = createPlugin("metrics", {
  depends: [runnerPlugin],
  hooks: ctx => ({
    "run:done": ({ runId, totals }) => ctx.log.info("run finished", { runId, spend: totals.spendUsd }),
    "run:failed": ({ runId, error }) => ctx.log.error("run failed", { runId, error })
  })
});
```

10.4 Plugin with its own API, state, and config (full shape):

```ts
import { createPlugin } from "@moku-labs/ai";

type Config = { greeting: string };
type State = { count: number };

export const counterPlugin = createPlugin("counter", {
  config: { greeting: "hello" } satisfies Config,
  createState: (): State => ({ count: 0 }),
  api: ctx => ({
    bump: () => {
      ctx.state.count += 1;
      ctx.log.info(ctx.config.greeting, { count: ctx.state.count });
      return ctx.state.count;
    }
  })
});
// app.counter.bump() after createApp({ plugins: [counterPlugin] }).start()
```

Every custom plugin's ctx automatically carries ctx.journal, ctx.store, ctx.limits,
ctx.log, ctx.env (core APIs) plus emit/require per its declarations. Family rules for
plugin source: render CLI output through @moku-labs/common/cli (MC1), log via ctx.log
(MC2), read env via ctx.env (MC3).

10.5 Testing conventions: mock the structural APIs (JournalApi/StoreApi/LimitsApi are
plain object types — fake object literals satisfy them); assemble a private framework
with createCore(coreConfig, { plugins: [...], pluginConfigs: { journal: { path: tmp },
store: { dir: tmp } } }) to pin core-plugin paths into a temp dir. Plugin tests live in
src/plugins/<name>/__tests__/{unit,integration}; root tests/ is framework-level only.
2858 tests in 195 files, 90% coverage threshold. Run: bun run test.
